$comment: Shared RFC selections for the measurement scripts in this directory.
'complexLayouts' is a curated set covering the document structures that have actually broken
narrow-screen layout, one entry per distinct structure rather than per document. Each note says
what the document is useful for, so a failure points at a cause rather than just a number. Add
to it whenever a new structure turns up a bug — that is cheaper than rediscovering it.
'firstXml2Rfc' is where the xml2rfc format starts. Earlier RFCs are published as plain text
inside <pre>, receive no word breaks at all, and dilute every proportion if sampled. A few
documents inside the range are plain text too; the scripts detect and skip those.
There is deliberately no highest-RFC value here: it would go stale silently, and it did.
latestPublishedRfc() in rfc-samples.ts reads the homepage's Latest RFCs each run instead. Note
RFC numbers are not contiguous — 10000 is unissued while 10001 and 10005 exist — so probing for
the first missing number reports the wrong answer.
See docs/mobile-layout/report.md for the measurements these selections produced.
